title: Feeding a 1-year-old doesn’t have to be complicated
summary: Here’s our easy chicken lunch idea
steps: I have mentioned it before it's so cool because it allows me to take any recipe video I like and it will import it into an actual recipe with ingredients and steps.

Mix everything then cook it on a medium heat.
